title: More crash-reversal horizons under the BTC-trend rule (2 trials) and rebuild with the Gen366 C2 construction (fixed: Sharpe-weighted on 2020-24)

trials.A 4-hour crash reversal: every 4 h (00/04/08/...): last 4 h return < -3 x (720 h hourly sd x sqrt 4) -> long 0.1 for 12 h, at most 8 open
trials.B 3-day crash reversal: daily: last 3-day return < -3 x (90-day daily sd x sqrt 3) -> long 0.1 for 5 days, at most 8 open

rules: BTC above its 200-day mean; limit orders; Bybit costs / funding; program entry bar vs the Gen366 book; robustness (k 2.5 / 3.5, one bar later); enter the C2 rebuild only if the rebuilt book's 2020-24 Sharpe rises
